summary: Align EKODI Admin internal canonical paths with the same five management work areas shown in the administrator navigation, while keeping Workspace as the canonical identity term.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI to hide the current-management-target line and to change administrator menu links together with their underlying subpaths so the Admin surface is consistent.
migrationPlan: Promote /admin/home, /admin/operations, /admin/workspaces, /admin/services and /admin/system as canonical groups. Continue accepting legacy common, professional, space and earlier mismatched group paths in the browser router and immediately canonicalize them to the five-area route.
securityModel: The route taxonomy changes presentation and navigation only. Person + Workspace + Role + Capability authorization, privileged elevation, audit, and the /admin security realm remain unchanged.
rollback: Restore admin-canonical-routes.js group ownership and service handoff URLs from the prior release while retaining the apex /admin security boundary.
verificationPolicy: Run constitution and architecture validation, Admin navigation and route contract tests, full repository checks, guarded staging/release, and real ekodi.kr/admin deep-route verification.
